story_title: As the assigned Event Coordinator, I want to see the Safety Officer's decision and act on it so that the event's arrangements are corrected and it can be approved to proceed

acceptance_criteria.text: The Coordinator can view the latest safety decision for the event, with the reason or the changes required, and the history of earlier decisions.
Given the Safety Officer requested changes or rejected the safety arrangement, when the decision is recorded, then the event status returns to Planning.

The Coordinator can flag the venue bookings and equipment arrangements affected by the decision for review; flagged arrangements are not cancelled or changed automatically (see: Review Flagged Arrangements).
After making the required changes, the Coordinator can submit the event for a safety check again (see: Submit Event for Operational Safety Check).

Given the event is safety-approved, when a significant change is made to its date, time, expected attendance, venue bookings or equipment arrangements, then the approval no longer applies and the event must be submitted for a safety check again.

Given the event is in Safety Review, when the Coordinator saves a significant change to its information or arrangements (the same changes as above, identified as in Update Event Information, SPM-62), then the pending safety check is closed, the event returns to Planning, and it must be submitted again once the arrangements are updated.
An ordinary edit that does not affect arrangements does not remove a safety approval or close a pending safety check.
Given the event has not been approved by the Safety Officer, when the Coordinator attempts to confirm it, then confirmation is refused and the outstanding Operational Safety Check is identified.
Given the event has been approved by the Safety Officer and its other required arrangements are complete, when the Coordinator confirms it, then confirmation succeeds as before.
The Safety Officer's reasons and required changes are visible to internal users only, not to the Event Organiser.

Logged in as Event Coordinator Daniel Tan (daniel.tan@connectsphere.com / password123).

Event: SPM88 Harbour Returned Forum (Planning)
Submission 1: rejected - Fire exits are blocked by the stage set.
Submission 2: changes requested - Add a second fire marshal at the east exit.
test_cases.expected_result: Step 2: The status is 'Planning'. The 'Safety check' row in Details reads 'Changes requested · decided by Hana Yusof, 9 Oct 2026, 10:00. A 'Safety check history' card lists both submissions, newest first: 'Submitted by Daniel Tan, 8 Oct 2026, 14:00 - Changes requested by Hana Yusof, 9 Oct 2026, 10:00. Changes required: Add a second fire marshal at the east exit.' and 'Submitted by Daniel Tan, 5 Oct 2026, 14:00 - Rejected by Hana Yusof, 6 Oct 2026, 10:00. Reason: Fire exits are blocked by the stage set.'

open_questions: RESOLVED 2026-10-15: AC1 - the latest decision stays in SPM-86/87's 'Safety check' row; a 'Safety check history' card on the event Overview lists every submission, newest first, for internal users only (TC01, TC02).

RESOLVED 2026-10-15: AC3 - after a returned check (changes requested or rejected) the assigned coordinator gets 'Flag arrangements for review' on the Overview: a dialog of the event's venue bookings and equipment with tick boxes. Ticked ones are flagged with the reason code safety_check_returned ('the Safety Officer returned the safety check'); nothing else changes. Clearing them is SPM-68 (merged 2026-10-15) - Keep on Flagged Arrangements or the Readiness tab. A flagged arrangement blocks resubmission (SPM-86 AC2) until kept or replaced (TC03, TC04).

RESOLVED 2026-10-15: A 'significant change' (AC5, AC6) is the coordinator's own save of: an important information change (date or time, expected attendance, venue requirements - SPM-62's importantChanges()), equipment added, changed or removed, or a venue booking requested, withdrawn or released (SPM-67). Other roles' actions (Venue Staff approving, Technical Support reserving, a venue or equipment marked unavailable) already flag the arrangement and are not counted.

RESOLVED 2026-10-15: Team decision confirmed - Update Event Information (SPM-62) is allowed in Safety review and Safety approved too. A significant edit closes the check and returns the event to Planning; an ordinary edit leaves it as it is (TC07, TC09, TC11).

RESOLVED 2026-10-15: 'The approval no longer applies' (AC5): a Safety approved event returns to Planning and its approved SafetyCheck is marked 'closed', so the Readiness tab shows 'Not submitted'. A Confirmed event that a significant change already returns to Planning (SPM-62) has its approval closed the same way, so it needs a new check before it can be confirmed again (TC12).

RESOLVED 2026-10-15: The confirm gate (AC8, AC9) is SPM-33's SAFETY_CHECK_BLOCKS_CONFIRMATION, turned on. 'Confirm event' is still offered in Planning and refused naming the safety check; from Safety approved it succeeds as before (TC08, TC09, TC12, TC13).

RESOLVED 2026-10-15: Other stories' test cases that confirm an event straight from Planning without an approved safety check (e.g. SPM-34's) are now refused. They are listed under Known Gaps in DOCUMENTATION.md as out of date and their owners told; their fixtures are not changed here.
RESOLVED 2026-10-15: No new notification - none of the criteria ask for one when a check is closed.

DECIDED 2026-10-15: Wording - 'Safety check history' card, one line per submission: 'Submitted by <name>, <date and time> - <Changes requested | Rejected | Approved> by <name>, <date and time>. <Changes required | Reason>: <note>', 'Awaiting review' while pending, 'Closed after a change on <date and time>: <what changed>' once closed. The 'Safety check' row for a closed check: 'Closed after a change on <date and time>: <what changed>'. Flagging: button 'Flag arrangements for review', dialog of the same name with 'Venue: <room>' / 'Equipment: <item>' tick boxes, 'Flag for review' / 'Cancel', 'Choose at least one arrangement to flag.', '<n> arrangement(s) flagged for review. Nothing has been changed or cancelled.', flag reason 'the Safety Officer returned the safety check'. Edits: the 'Move this event back to Planning?' dialog adds that the safety check is closed or the approval cancelled and the event must be submitted for a safety check again; the save message becomes 'Event information updated. The event is back in Planning and needs to be submitted for a safety check again.'

DECIDED 2026-10-15: Fixtures (scripts/seed-spm88.ts, written with the code) - a dedicated venue 'SPM88 Harbour Studio'; events, each with an approved booking there and a Reserved Handheld Wireless Mic (2), coordinator Daniel Tan, organiser Rachel Ng, dated November 2027: 'SPM88 Harbour Returned Forum' (Planning; checks: rejected 5/6 Oct 2026, changes requested 8/9 Oct 2026, as in TC01), 'SPM88 Riverside Review' (Safety review, pending), 'SPM88 Approved Gala' (Safety approved, attendance 60), 'SPM88 Approved Seminar' (Safety approved), 'SPM88 Pending Showcase' (Safety review), 'SPM88 Pending Workshop' (Safety review), 'SPM88 Confirmed Expo' (Confirmed on 18 Nov 2027, its check approved), 'SPM88 Unchecked Launch' (Planning, never submitted).
